Session 13 Asset Checklist — The Council and the Wall

Prep: @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.7d4fa8464aee96dc]{session13 prep} · Castle assets: rosehold asset list Audit: 2026-10-16. File presence means the source exists, not that it is imported or placed in the live world. World state is from the 2026-10-10 staging notes in 00 campaign state.

✅ Existing assets

Use Existing source Readiness / setup
Runnable session @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.7d4fa8464aee96dc]{session13 prep} and seven scene notes Complete
Dragon's Cave (scene 1) GM-confirmed existing world map; module fallback Dragon Cave Lair Reuse. Remove Tawny's token; hide Embra
The Road Beyond (scene 2) Module scene Scorchwoods — The Road Beyond Imported and staged 2026-10-10
Castle Approach (scenes 2–3) Module scene Castle Approach; maps/morwennas castle/rosehold 0 thornwall player.png In the navigation bar, hidden from players until activated
Level 0 (scenes 4–6) Module scene Rosehold 0 — The Thornwall Imported and populated 2026-10-10; Barrier waves (6 crawlers, 3 wisps) placed hidden. Copy 6 more crawlers for round 2. Walls untested in play
Level 1 (scene 7, optional) Module scene Rosehold 1 — The Outer Ward Imported and populated 2026-10-10
Castle actors World "Rosehold" actor folder (30 actors): Awakened Tree, Castle Vine Crawler, Frostbind Wisp, Thornheart Construct, Hilde, Thornsworn Guard and Sergeant Ready
Amy (restored), Scamp, Finnian, Robin, Raphael, Royal Guard Module actors (0.7.0) In the world from session 12
Daisy of Silverspire GM-made actor already in the world Scene 3
Portraits npcs/assets/princess amy.png, npcs/assets/sir finnian.png, npcs/assets/sir raphael.png, npcs/assets/unicorn aurelius full power.png, npcs/assets/nim the badger.png, npcs/assets/pippin cobbleton.png, monsters/assets/awakened tree.png, monsters/assets/vine crawler.png On disk

❌ Gaps and setup decisions

Priority Need Suggested target or action
🔴 HIGH Major Ursa actor Art is done: portrait npcs/assets/major ursa.png, token npcs/assets/major ursa token.png, full body npcs/assets/major ursa full.png. Hand-make the actor in the world from @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-actors.Actor.420ce96ef2fb0f2c]{Major Ursa} (HP 8, SAVE 10, Armor 2; Bite d10, Claws d6) and upload the two images
🔴 HIGH Players' special items Collect designs before play; hand-make each item on the PC's sheet after the GM approves it
🔴 HIGH Ally Calls journal in the world is the session 12 copy Edit it by hand (two rows: crystal wolves → Major Ursa; Finnian now available) or re-import from a new module build
🟢 LOW Dragon-scale armour items (+3 Armor each) Hand-make per PC if not done after session 12
🟢 LOW Hilde's Buckler item Hand-make if the world has no copy; text in @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.f4b0b12b4e9ee480]{Rosehold Treasures}
